cross_source_reconciliation.result: Same architectural lineage but Drive is later than the frozen head. Frozen-head router lacks the later separate VERLAUF_BUDGET_CHARS/GESAMT_DECKEL_CHARS context-budget repair and reasoning_content fallback present in Drive. Preserve Drive as later/uncommitted delta rather than declaring identity.
confirmed_later_drive_fixes: Conversation history gets an independent 8000-char budget instead of system+history sharing one 10000-char cap.
A 22000-char total emergency cap is derived from measured context/token ratio.
Non-stream completion can recover reasoning_content when llama.cpp leaves content empty.

semantic_findings.finding: The same Drive file describes/defaults as Qwen3.5-4B and initializes _last_model accordingly, but health/logging/route responses/startup identify qwen2.5-3b. Model identity is duplicated stale source text rather than one verified runtime fact.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Derive model identity from a verified loaded-artifact/runtime manifest.

semantic_findings.finding: Later Drive code documents a measured failure where one 10000-char cap caused 0/9 conversation steps to reach the model as system text grew, then repairs it with separate history and total budgets.
semantic_findings.inheritance: System/history/evidence/answer reserve need separate tokenizer-aware budgets and regression tests.

semantic_findings.finding: /ingest fully reads UploadFile before checking INGEST_MAX_BYTES.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Enforce streaming byte limits before buffering.

semantic_findings.finding: /ingest writes directly to host AICORE_DATA/inbox and returns its host path; authority is assumed from loopback transport.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Loopback is not authority; ingest is a typed storage effect mediated by Needle/capabilities and provenance.

semantic_findings.finding: RouteRequest accepts arbitrary system/messages; an existing system message over 500 chars suppresses identity merge on the assumption that a trusted overlay already supplied identity/context.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Only trusted internal assemblies may acquire system authority; user-originated fields cannot become SystemAssembly by placement/length.

semantic_findings.finding: The repair derives 3.86 chars/token from measurement but runtime trimming still counts characters, so model/tokenizer changes can invalidate the approximation.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Budget calibration must be versioned to the actual tokenizer/model and checked in Harness.

semantic_findings.finding: /health can prove endpoint health while returning a hard-coded qwen2.5-3b label unrelated to the actually loaded artifact.
semantic_findings.inheritance: Health must expose verified runtime artifact/tokenizer/build identity and readiness contract.

frank: Eliminate duplicated model-identity literals; body/model identity comes from runtime evidence.
needle: Treat system/context authority and ingest storage as explicit capabilities.
harness: Add model-identity consistency, tokenizer-budget, long-system-history, read-before-limit and caller-system-authority tests.
claycode: Represent ContextBudget, SystemAssembly and ModelRuntime as typed values with provenance.
unifieddb: Persist active model/tokenizer/build identity and context-budget calibration epoch.
claygraph: Preserve frozen-head vs later Drive router as chronological nodes with measured history-loss repair.
gwt: Workspace resource arbitration must prevent system-text growth from silently evicting all prior relevant context.
clay: One-module fusion should use one runtime truth source for identity while retaining measured resource budgets.
